newsitem.title: USA: Serologicals gets FDA letter on donor unit.
newsitem.headline: Serologicals gets FDA letter on donor unit.

text.p: ATLANTA, Sept 26 (Reuter) Serologicals Corp said Thursday that its subsidiary, Serologicals Inc, has received a Food and Drug Administration letter regarding protocols at one of its 39 donor centers.

The letter follows a routine annual inspection and sought "further explanation from the company regarding verification of 'physician on premise' during certain operations, and the extent of its response concerning the training of an individual to perform certain tasks," the company said.
Serologicals said it has contacted the FDA and that the FDA has agreed with its response.
The company said it "does not expect these issues to have any material adverse effect on its operations."

Serologicals's services include donor recruitment, donor management and clinical testing, which it said it uses to provide products that treat diseases in newborns, rabies, hepatitis and in diagnostic products.
In August, another subsidiary of the company, Seramune, also received an FDA letter regarding one of its donor centers, which the company said it responded to with a corrective action plan.
